name: Show me top 5 branches by net sales this month, sorted highest first
sql:
SELECT TOP 5
    b.BranchShortName          AS Branch,
    SUM(s.SaleNetAmount)       AS NetSales
FROM  dbo.VwAISalesData  s
JOIN  dbo.VwAIBranch     b  ON s.BranchId = b.BranchId
WHERE s.InvoiceDt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1)
  AND s.InvoiceDt <= CAST(GETDATE() AS date)
GROUP BY b.BranchShortName
ORDER BY NetSales DESC
